def factor_volume_instability_range_gated(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_std = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    cv = vol_std / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    cv = cv.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    range_stability = -range_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    weight = 1.0 + 0.5 * np.tanh(range_stability)
    df_copy["factor_volume_instability_range_gated"] = cv * weight
    return df_copy["factor_volume_instability_range_gated"]
description: Crossover of two qualified parents. Primary mechanism: alpha-liq-0002's coefficient of variation of trailing 20-day volume, capturing instability in liquidity provision. Secondary lightweight idea from stability_range_smooth_gen0_001: range stability, defined as negative rolling 20-day standard deviation of the daily range-to-close ratio. The child attenuates the volume instability signal when the price range itself is volatile (range_stability strongly negative), because volume instability in turbulent-range regimes may reflect common market volatility rather than idiosyncratic liquidity fragility. In calm-range regimes the volume instability signal is preserved or slightly amplified. This bounded continuous weight (0.5 to 1.5 via tanh) preserves cross-sectional variation and targets improvement in MI and payoff thickness while retaining the primary parent's ICIR/RankICIR and strong payoff evidence.
